26 October 2026 — target charging dominates delivered savings in the classical pilot

The stronger conventional test is closed. One source-bound campaign (b44d08eb, managed owner72484) and one compact readout (3f461bbd/1eedda65) each ran once and exited0. Four prospectively selected exposed FIT groups, 10007/10013 at20 trips and10017/10021 at28, gave eight paired tariff contexts and sixteen paid stages. Every target-QP common incumbent qualified, all sixteen operational endpoints were timely and independently replayed, and all eight joint MIQP stages delivered qualified physical candidates. There were no failures, missing comparisons or qualification discrepancies. Six MIQPs returned native OPTIMAL; both10021 targets reached TIME_LIMIT. Partial binary starts were submitted; actual native start processing remainsUNKNOWN.

The full-eight mean added routing increment beyond the already target-charged common plan was0.18127943 generator cost units. The mean of paired (F_QP−F_retained)/E_QP ratios was0.10624451%, where E_QP is each target common incumbent's ELECTRICITY cost. This is not a percentage of total bill, a ratio of averages, old warmE0 or catalogEbar. For comparison, unchanged-schedule→fixed-route target charging delivered18.62186109 units of mean improvement. Every context remains in these complete denominators.

Only10017 improved beyond the existing source point-agreement screens: source0 gained1.27932907 units (0.75199059%E_QP), source1 gained0.17090635 (0.09796549%E_QP). The other six rows were zero or numerical-scale points, preserved exactly. On flat-price source0,10017 used5.9333 MORE grid kWh; linear electricity cost increased1.186667 units while quadratic cost decreased2.465996, yielding the net1.279329 gain. Under source1, energy fell0.06667kWh, linear cost .02000 and quadratic .150906 units. Operations/fleet costs were unchanged. This is a conventional joint point tradeoff, not learned tariff information or a separately identified access mechanism.

The two10021 time-limited points delivered no improvement, with raw native relative MIP gaps0.00654695/0.00706959. These gaps concern the numerical native objective, not electricity-normalized or exact physical uncertainty. Intrinsic opportunity in that group remains unresolved. The six OPTIMAL labels and point-agreement screens also do not prove ideal route equivalence or unrestricted EVSP optimality. No favorable-case longer run, retry, replacement, lowered learning gate or new fit follows. Four exposed groups remain four development units, not eight independent timetables or final generalization.

The earlier screening limitation is removed in this test: a single convex MIQP jointly optimizes the full declared movement graph and charging at the exact reference fleet, with qualified common U protected externally. Reference N is feasible, not a proven minimum/day-economic optimum. Original resources remain unchanged; objective is integrated system cost ops+a'L+0.5L'BL, not atomic payment. Acquisition, cold loading, build/copy, native search, extraction, replay, publication and parent observation are paid; the context has TWO worker anchors and a full pipeline clock, not one60-second or equal-budget speedup claim.

Scientific disposition: the present evidence does not justify more ML fitting or broad scale expansion. Competent charging captures most delivered cost reduction here, one group has a modest conventional routing point benefit and another remains numerically unresolved. Earlier both-family warm DO_NOT_CONTINUE decisions stand. Next is a source-only gate on material operating stakes, consistent economic units/institutions and valuable conditional targets before any new data/compute. Existing classical feasibility/access observations are useful, but do not supply a new theorem or a learning contribution. No training, manuscript, sealed-data or new experiment is automatically authorized.
